datasheet_identity.title: MM1Z2V0 THRU MM1Z75 SOD-123 Surface Mount Silicon Zener Diodes

extraction_notes: Family datasheet MM1Z2V0 THRU MM1Z75; MM1Z27 row (type code 5P): VZ min/nom/max = 25.1/27/28.9 V at IZT = 5 mA; ZZT = 70 ohm at IZT; IR = 0.1 uA at VR = 21 V (p. 2).
ZZT = 70 ohm at IZT = 5 mA has no schema slot and is recorded here verbatim.
Maximum ratings (never fitted): PD = 500 mW, Tj = -55 to +150 degC, RthJA = 340 degC/W (p. 1).
Full manufacturer name on the datasheet: Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd (www.ichjc.com).

Fig.2 (p. 3) contains 7 labeled curves (10, 12, 15, 18, 22, 27, 33 V); the 6th path from the left, matching the '27' label position and ordering, was digitized from the PDF vector path. Axes calibrated against tick labels; x linear 0-40 V, y linear 0-30 mA. The plotted 27 V curve knee leaves the voltage axis near 25.85 V and the curve terminates at 12.1 mA / 27.07 V.
Curve y-values converted from the plotted mA axis to A.

The p. 2 and p. 3 tables both carry an MM1Z43 row with different values (p. 2: IZT 3.7 mA, ZZT 150 ohm; p. 3: IZT 2.5 mA, ZZT 130 ohm); this source inconsistency does not affect MM1Z27, which appears once.
No per-part capacitance value is published anywhere in this datasheet; capacitance is null.

Fig.1 (zener characteristics 2V7-8V2, other parts), Fig.3 (power derating) and Fig.4 (transient thermal impedance) were not digitized: other-part or thermal family curves, not per-part electrical model inputs.
